summary: The customer called to demand an immediate refund of $250 after being incorrectly charged for a cancelled installation order. The agent acknowledged the billing error, processed the refund request, and explained the standard 3 to 5 business day processing time. Dissatisfied with the timeframe, the customer demanded an instant transfer and requested a supervisor escalation, which the agent facilitated.

evidence.text: The refund has been initiated, but please allow three to five business days for it to appear on your statement.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Process a refund of $250 to the customer's credit card within three to five business days.

evidence.text: Your feedback has been noted in the system, and the supervisor will have all the details. Connecting you now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Transfer the customer to a supervisor and document the feedback in the system.

evidence.text: I am very sorry about the long wait time, and I understand you are upset. I would be happy to help you with a refund.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent remained calm, polite, and professional throughout the call despite the customer's hostility and profanity.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration regarding an unexpected charge. I am looking at your account history right now...
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly validated the customer's feelings and took responsibility for the company's oversight.

evidence.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor, but please be aware that the queue for a supervisor callback is currently about fifteen minutes due to high volume.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully identified the error and initiated the refund, though the customer ultimately required a supervisor escalation due to the processing timeline.

evidence.text: I wish I could force an instant transfer, Mr. Davis, but our banking merchant processor requires three to five business days for electronic refunds to clear back to a credit card.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained processes, policies, and timelines clearly and directly.

evidence.text: I am transferring you to a supervisor now, Mr. Davis. Please stay on the line and the next available manager will assist you.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended with a clear handoff to a supervisor as requested by the customer.

evidence.text: It looks like the cancellation ticket was processed, but the billing hold wasn't released before the automated billing cycle ran.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the root cause of the billing error from the account history.

evidence.text: Can I please have your account number and the phone number associated with it?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper verification procedures and executed the correct steps for investigating a billing error and processing a refund.

quote.text: Finally, someone picked up. I have been on hold for twenty minutes, and I am furious. I want my money back right now.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: My account number is 449281039 and you already have my phone number. More importantly, you charged my credit card for a service installation order that I cancelled two weeks ago!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: You better look into it quickly. I cancelled that order within the allowed window, yet you still billed me two hundred and fifty dollars. This is outright theft.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Three to five business days? No, unacceptable! You took my money instantly, so you need to put it back instantly. I want an expedited transfer right now.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: That is a cop-out! I want to speak to your supervisor immediately. I am not accepting this garbage excuse.
quote.speaker: Customer
